rows.en:
(Let's see, next up is Lectures...
Come to think of it, I wonder who our teacher
will be? I'm kind of looking forward to it.)
rows.notes: zagaku (classroom study) -> 'Lectures', matching the schedule help u5458 ('Attend lectures'); not in the glossary.

rows.en: Um, excuse me...
Yes?

I forgot my textbook...
Would you mind sharing yours with me?
Sure, of course.

Oh, I'm Yuu Akimizu!
Nice to meet you!

I'm \p.
Nice to meet you too.

I'm really sorry.
I lent my textbook to a friend and forgot
to get it back...
That's rough. Don't be shy, go ahead and look.

Anyway, I wonder what kind of teacher
we'll get. Aren't you excited?
Yeah, I was wondering about that too.
Oh, looks like the teacher's here.

I am Pinon Colette-sensei, and I'll be
teaching your "Lectures" class.
rows.notes: Pinon calls herself Pinon Colette-sensei. Class name 'Lectures' as in c21247.

rows.en:
I'll explain things extremely gently so even
the likes of you can understand, so be grateful
and take my class!

Wait, um...
No matter how you look at it, she looks like
an elementary schooler, right?

Yes, she does...
But...
But?
That girl... is sooo cute...

Huh?!
O-oh, y-yeah, I guess...

(I don't think whether she's cute or not
is the point right now...)

Pinon-kun, what are you doing
in someone else's class?
Ack! Yamashiro!

My apologies for being late.
It seems someone hid my textbook...

I'm Itsuki Yamashiro, and I'll be in charge
of the "Lectures" class.

Oh, I knew it.
I mean, Pinon-chan being a teacher
was kind of a stretch...
No, it's no lie that Pinon-kun is a teacher.

She falls into the category of genius.
At her age, she already holds a teaching license.
That's right, I'm amazing!

I intend to have her teach Special Lectures.
So the "teacher" part is, technically, true.
rows.notes: tokushu zagaku -> 'Special Lectures' (follows 'Lectures'); not in the glossary.

rows.en:
That's right, I'm a teacher!
You lot! Show some respect and call me
Pinon-sensei!

However, Pinon-kun...
You're supposed to be a teacher AND a student.
And I'm the one teaching this class.

Which means right now you're just a student...
Would you take a seat over there?
And take off the lab coat, too.

Grr!
You'll pay for this, Yamashiro!

Damn you, Yamashiro!
I knew I should've hidden it somewhere
harder to find...
Nice to meet you, Pinon-chan.
Nice to meet you too, Pinon-chan!
I told you to call me Pinon-sensei...!
Now then, let's begin class.
(Pinon-sensei and Yamashiro-sensei, huh...)

(It's not just the students...
Mihoshi's got plenty of quirky teachers too...)

(Let's see, next up is Lectures...
Come to think of it, I wonder who our teacher
will be? I'm kind of looking forward to it.)
Sure, of course you can.

I'm \p.
Nice to meet you too.
That's rough. Don't be shy, go ahead and look.
Yeah, I was wondering about that too.

Huh?!
O-oh, y-yeah, I guess...

(It's not just the students...
Mihoshi's got plenty of quirky teachers too...)

(Ugh, this is bad...
I was only trying to get to the library,
and now I'm lost inside my own school...)

Oh? Do you need one of the third-years?
If you'd like, I can go get them for you.
rows.notes: Claire ('??? (woman)'). Neutral 'them' for the unspecified senior.

rows.en:
Well, you were standing around puzzling
in front of the third-year classrooms.
Wouldn't anyone assume that?

Oh, no, that's not it.
I was actually trying to get to the library
and got lost...

The library's in the complete opposite direction...
How on earth did you end up here?

Hehe, you're a funny one.
Oh well, I'll take you to the library myself.

Running into each other like this must be fate.
It's no trouble at all.

Thank you very much.
Um...

It's Claire. Claire Stanford.
Nice to meet you.

I'm \p.
It's nice to meet you too.
Well then, shall we get going...?
Waaah! Claire~!
Klan, what's wrong?

Michel...
That jerk Michel made fun of me agaaain~
Aww, there, there.
(A-a kid...?)

Sorry, \p-kun...
Would you mind waiting a little
before I show you to the library?
Sure, no problem.

Hm! You're a first-year in the Pilot Course,
aren't you?

If you see Michel, give him a message! Tell him
Klan Klang said, "Next time we meet,
I'm gonna beat you to a pulp!!"
(Michel, what on earth did you do to this kid...?)

Sorry, Klan.
I have to take this one to the library.
I see. Sorry for holding you up, then.

...Oh, come to think of it,
I haven't asked your name yet.
I'm \p.

All right, \p...
If you don't pass that on to Michel,
be ready for a punishment to match!

Mm, as long as you understand.
See you.
Well then, let's get going too.

By the way, Claire-senpai...
Did Klan-senpai skip a grade or something?
Klan and I are the same age.

Apparently, when she micronizes,
her body turns into a little kid's.

Here we are, this is the library.
Think you can make it here on your own
next time without getting lost?

I-I'll be fine!
Sorry for making you show me the way...
